summary: The candidate moves the missing-charge check ahead of the hosted-runtime, release-terminal and cooldown gates in ingestClosedCWave, so an all-absent C wave reaches ClosedCWaveUnrecoverableSkipV1 before a cooldown can abort the pass. Regression tests cover repair and release cooldowns with null and future retry bounds and assert later recovery phases continue, and a recoverable wave still respects the cooldown.

evidence: src/host/modern-matrix-recovery.ts lines 807-825 call requireClosedCWaveCharges before the hosted-runtime, release-terminal and cooldown gates and before recoverClosedWave.

tests/host/modern-matrix-recovery-archive_test.ts lines 230-294 exercise all-absent and archived-absent waves with repair and release cooldown rows and assert the typed skip and continued maintenance.
tests/host/modern-matrix-recovery-archive_test.ts lines 297-310 assert a recoverable wave still rejects with the cooldown error.
